description: Spring Line Advisory lead was logged in My Leads.xlsx with 'Passed To: Me' (David O'Hara) when the lead belongs to Devlin Liles — he made the intro. correction: Update My Leads.xlsx row for Spring Line Advisory — Passed To should reflect Devlin Liles, not David. Master must pass full lead attribution context (who sourced it, who owns the AM relationship) when spawning Chase for lead logging.
